image_prompts: A stack of books, the top one with a name tag attached to its cover
A lost glove hanging on a fence, a small 'lost and found' sign nearby

words.collocations: whose book, whose idea, whose fault

examples.en: Whose pen is this? Is it yours or your brother's?

socratic_questions.question: 你想问这本书属于谁，你会用哪个词来引导你的问题？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词用来询问所有权或归属关系。

A toy truck filled with colorful building blocks on a playroom floor

words.preposition_combos: in a truck, on a truck, by truck

examples.en: The truck driver delivered the packages to our school today.

socratic_questions.question: 如果你需要运输大量的货物，你会选择什么交通工具？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种交通工具通常很大，可以装很多东西，在公路上行驶。

sentences: The farmer used his ___ to transport the harvested crops to market.

image_prompts: A fluffy white rabbit sitting in a green meadow, long ears perked up
A rabbit silhouette against a full moon, surrounded by tall grass

words.image_desc_cn: 图片展示了草地上的兔子和兔子轮廓。

words.preposition_combos: rabbit in the hat, rabbit with long ears

examples.en: The little rabbit hopped quickly across the grassy field.
examples.cn: 小兔子迅速地跳过草地。

examples.cn: 我的妹妹养了一只宠物兔，它非常可爱。

socratic_questions.question: 什么动物以胡萝卜为食，并且以其长耳朵和蓬松的尾巴而闻名？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种动物通常在花园或田野里发现，并且是复活节的象征。

sentences: The magician pulled a white ___ out of his hat.

image_prompts: A calendar with a specific date circled, representing a planned event
A crowded auditorium with many seats filled, focused on the stage
words.image_desc_en: A calendar marking an event and a full auditorium.
words.image_desc_cn: 日历上标记的事件和坐满的礼堂。
words.collocations: attend a meeting, attend school, attend to
words.preposition_combos: attend to (处理), attend on (服侍)

examples.en: I will attend the English club meeting this Friday.
examples.cn: 我将参加这个星期五的英语俱乐部会议。

examples.en: You should attend class regularly to improve your grades.
examples.cn: 你应该经常上课以提高你的成绩。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你计划去某个地方或参与某个活动，你会怎么说？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示你将亲自到场。

sentences: Did you ___ the science fair last weekend at school?

image_prompts: A golden antique pocket watch with intricate carvings, displayed on velvet
A collection of rare stamps in a protective album, magnifying glass nearby
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations representing precious and important items.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表珍贵和重要物品的插图。
words.collocations: valuable information, valuable experience, valuable asset

examples.en: This old book is very valuable because it's a first edition.
examples.cn: 这本旧书非常贵重，因为它是第一版。

examples.en: Learning a new language can be a valuable skill for your future.
examples.cn: 学习一门新语言对你的未来来说可能是一项有价值的技能。

socratic_questions.question: 什么东西不仅价格高昂，而且对你的人生有重要意义？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 它可能不是金钱能衡量的，但对你来说非常重要。

sentences: The museum has a collection of ___ ancient artifacts from around the world.

image_prompts: A collection of pink roses in full bloom, soft lighting
A pink flamingo standing in shallow water, reflection visible
words.image_desc_en: Images of pink roses and a pink flamingo.
words.image_desc_cn: 粉色玫瑰和粉色火烈鸟的图像。
words.collocations: light pink, dark pink, pink dress

examples.en: She wore a pink dress to the school party last night.
examples.cn: 她昨晚穿着一件粉色的连衣裙去参加学校聚会了。

examples.en: The sunset painted the sky in shades of pink and orange.
examples.cn: 日落将天空染成了粉色和橙色的色调。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想描述一种颜色，它比红色浅，比白色深，你会用什么词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种颜色常与浪漫和女性气质联系在一起。

sentences: The cherry blossoms were a beautiful shade of ___ this spring.

image_prompts: A silhouette of a crowd with one figure highlighted in bright light
An empty stage with a single spotlight shining on the center
words.image_desc_en: A representation of someone among many or a single person standing out.
words.image_desc_cn: 人群中的一个身影被照亮，或空旷舞台上的一束聚光灯，代表任何人。
words.collocations: hardly anybody, almost anybody

examples.en: Does anybody know the answer to this difficult question?
examples.cn: 有谁知道这个难题的答案吗？

examples.en: If anybody calls, please tell them I will be back soon.
examples.cn: 如果有人打电话来，请告诉他们我很快回来。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你需要帮助，你会向谁寻求帮助？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示任何可能提供帮助的人。

sentences: Is there ___ who can help me with my homework tonight?

image_prompts: A computer screen displaying a list of pronouns with clear definitions.
A grammar textbook open to a page explaining different types of pronouns.
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations representing pronouns and their grammatical function.
words.image_desc_cn: 表示代词及其语法功能的插图。
words.usage: v. (过去式 pronned, 过去分词 pronned)
words.collocations: pron on/upon

examples.en: I pron this plan because it benefits everyone involved.
examples.cn: 我赞成这个计划，因为它使所有相关人员受益。

examples.en: She pronned the new school rules after understanding their purpose.
examples.cn: 在理解了新校规的目的后，她赞成这些校规。

socratic_questions.question: 如果有人对一个提议表示完全的同意和支持，你会怎么描述他们的态度？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示积极地支持或赞同某事。

sentences: The committee decided to ___ the proposal after a long discussion.

image_prompts: A dark, winding staircase in an old mansion, shadows and dust motes
A locked antique wooden chest with ornate carvings, a question mark above it
words.image_desc_en: Visuals representing something unknown and puzzling.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表未知和令人困惑的事物的视觉效果。
words.collocations: solve a mystery, deep mystery, air of mystery

examples.en: The old house held a deep mystery that no one could solve.
examples.cn: 那栋老房子隐藏着一个无人能解的谜团。

examples.en: It's a mystery how she finished the test so quickly.
examples.cn: 她怎么这么快完成考试真是个谜。

socratic_questions.question: 侦探小说里，通常会发生什么让人困惑又想知道答案的事情？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指难以理解、原因不明的事情。

sentences: The disappearance of the valuable painting remains a complete ___.

image_prompts: A famous landmark with a sign indicating its popular name
A book cover displaying the author's name and a well-known title
words.image_desc_en: A landmark with a sign showing its popular name; a book cover with a famous title.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个地标，标志显示其常用名；一本图书封面，显示著名标题。
words.collocations: be widely known as, be also known as
words.preposition_combos: known as a, known as the

examples.en: That city is known as the 'City of Gardens' for its beauty.
examples.cn: 那个城市因其美丽而被称为“花园之城”。

examples.en: He is known as a talented artist in our local community.
examples.cn: 他在我们当地社区被认为是一位有才华的艺术家。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个地方因为它的某个特点而出名，我们通常会怎么描述它？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示某事物因其特性或名声而被人们所知。

sentences: The Great Wall is ___ one of the world's wonders.

image_prompts: A complex diagram illustrating a scientific concept with interconnected lines and nodes
A chalkboard covered in mathematical equations and symbols, representing abstract ideas
words.image_desc_en: Visual representations of abstract concepts and scientific principles.
words.image_desc_cn: 抽象概念和科学原理的可视化呈现。
words.collocations: in theory, theory and practice, scientific theory

examples.en: His theory about space travel is interesting but needs more proof.
examples.cn: 他关于太空旅行的理论很有趣，但需要更多的证据。

examples.en: The teacher explained the basic theory of gravity to the class.
examples.cn: 老师向全班解释了重力的基本理论。

socratic_questions.question: 科学家们用来解释自然现象，但尚未完全证实的想法是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 它是一种解释事物运作方式的框架，但可能需要进一步验证。

sentences: The Big Bang ___ is the prevailing explanation for the universe's origin.

image_prompts: A well-worn leather armchair next to a fireplace, soft lighting
A street with similar-looking houses on both sides, a cozy neighborhood
words.image_desc_en: A comfortable armchair and a street with similar houses.
words.image_desc_cn: 舒适的扶手椅和一条两旁是相似房屋的街道。
words.collocations: familiar with, become familiar, look familiar

examples.en: The park is a familiar place for our family picnics.
examples.cn: 这个公园是我们家熟悉的野餐地点。

examples.en: His face looked familiar, but I couldn't remember his name.
examples.cn: 他的脸看起来很熟悉，但我记不起他的名字了。

socratic_questions.question: 当你再次看到你经常去的地方时，你会有什么感觉？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个地方不是第一次见，你之前已经去过很多次了。

sentences: The melody was ___, but I couldn't place where I had heard it.

image_prompts: A treasure chest buried in sand, partially visible, X marks the spot
A key concealed under a stack of books on a dusty shelf
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations showing something concealed or not easily seen.
words.image_desc_cn: 展示某物被隐藏或不容易被看到的插图。
words.collocations: hidden treasure, hidden costs, hidden talent

examples.en: The entrance to the secret garden was hidden by thick bushes.
examples.cn: 通往秘密花园的入口被茂密的灌木丛隐藏了起来。

examples.en: A hidden camera recorded everything that happened in the room.
examples.cn: 一个隐藏的摄像头记录了房间里发生的一切。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想把你的日记藏起来，你会把它放在哪里？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容不容易被发现的状态。

sentences: The cat was ___ under the bed, sleeping soundly.

image_prompts: A lightning bolt striking a wind turbine, generating electricity
A dam holding back a large body of water, showcasing hydroelectric energy
words.image_desc_en: Lightning striking a turbine; a dam holding water.
words.image_desc_cn: 闪电击中涡轮机；水坝蓄水。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 powered, 过去分词 powered)
words.collocations: have the power to, power plant, power supply

examples.en: The sun has the power to provide energy for our planet.
examples.cn: 太阳有能力为我们的星球提供能量。

examples.en: The government has the power to make important decisions for the country.
examples.cn: 政府有权力为国家做出重要决定。

socratic_questions.question: 什么东西可以驱动机器运转，或者让一个人能够控制局面？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词既可以指物理上的能量，也可以指一种控制或影响的能力。

sentences: Wind ___ is a clean and renewable source of energy for the future.

image_prompts: Two metal chain links connected together, close-up
A hyperlink on a computer screen, cursor hovering over it
words.image_desc_en: Two metal chain links connected together; A hyperlink on a computer screen.
words.image_desc_cn: 两个金属链环连接在一起；电脑屏幕上的超链接。
words.usage: v. (过去式 linked, 过去分词 linked); n.
words.collocations: strong link, weak link, link to, link between

examples.en: This road will link the town to the main highway soon.
examples.cn: 这条路很快会将城镇与主要高速公路连接起来。

examples.en: There is a strong link between exercise and good health always.
examples.cn: 运动和健康之间总是存在着紧密的联系。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想把两个东西连接在一起，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示连接两个或多个事物。

sentences: The new bridge will ___ the two sides of the river.

image_prompts: Two straight train tracks stretching into the distance, converging at the horizon
A set of neatly arranged pencils on a desk, all pointing in the same direction
words.image_desc_en: Parallel lines or objects.
words.image_desc_cn: 平行线或平行物体。
words.collocations: run parallel to, draw parallel lines, parallel universe

examples.en: The road and the river run parallel to each other for miles.
examples.cn: 这条路和这条河流彼此平行延伸数英里。

examples.en: Our school's rules are parallel to those of other schools.
examples.cn: 我们学校的规章制度与其他学校的规章制度相似。

socratic_questions.question: 想象一下两条永远不会相交的铁路轨道，它们之间的关系是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述的是两条线永不相交的状态。

sentences: The two lines on the graph are ___ and never intersect.

image_prompts: A vast expanse of space with countless stars and galaxies, nebulae in the background
A swirling galaxy with bright stars and planets, cosmic dust clouds
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations of the vastness of space and galaxies.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘广阔的太空和星系的插图。
words.collocations: the whole universe, explore the universe
words.preposition_combos: in the universe, across the universe

examples.en: Scientists are trying to understand the origin of the universe.
examples.cn: 科学家们正试图了解宇宙的起源。

examples.en: The universe is so vast that we can't explore it all.
examples.cn: 宇宙如此浩瀚，我们无法完全探索它。

socratic_questions.question: 如果我们要描述所有存在的事物，包括地球、星星、和其他所有空间，我们会用哪个词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指的是包含一切的整体。

sentences: The ___ is full of mysteries that scientists are trying to solve.

image_prompts: Two separate galaxies swirling in opposite directions, connected by a faint bridge of light
A split image of a chessboard, one side with white pieces winning, the other with black pieces winning
words.image_desc_en: Visual representations of separate realities and alternate outcomes.
words.image_desc_cn: 独立现实和不同结果的视觉表现。
words.collocations: explore parallel universes, imagine parallel universes, theory of parallel universes
words.preposition_combos: in parallel universes, between parallel universes

examples.en: Some scientists believe that parallel universes may exist beyond our own.
examples.cn: 一些科学家认为，在我们自己的宇宙之外可能存在平行宇宙。

examples.en: The movie explores the concept of traveling to parallel universes.
examples.cn: 这部电影探索了旅行到平行宇宙的概念。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的生活有无数个版本，每个版本都略有不同，这会是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述的是多个同时存在的、与我们宇宙相似但又不同的空间。

sentences: The science fiction story featured characters jumping between different ___.

image_prompts: A pile of documents scattered on a desk, some with coffee stains
A luggage carousel with suitcases of different colors and sizes, some mismatched
words.image_desc_en: Documents scattered and suitcases mismatched, representing a mix-up.
words.image_desc_cn: 散落的文件和不匹配的行李箱，代表着混乱。
words.collocations: a mix-up in, a mix-up over
words.preposition_combos: in a mix-up, due to a mix-up

examples.en: There was a mix-up in the schedule, so we missed the bus.
examples.cn: 时间安排上出了差错，所以我们错过了公共汽车。

examples.en: The mix-up over the tickets caused a long delay at the gate.
examples.cn: 由于票务上的混乱，导致登机口延误了很久。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的作业交错了，或者你的航班信息不正确，这通常是什么情况？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指事情没有按计划进行，出现了错误。

sentences: Due to a ___ in communication, the meeting was postponed.

image_prompts: A world map with highlighted areas representing common travel destinations
A pie chart showing the most common hobbies among a group of people
words.image_desc_en: A world map showing common travel destinations; a pie chart of common hobbies.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张世界地图，突出显示了常见的旅行目的地；一张显示常见爱好的饼图。
words.collocations: generally speaking, generally accepted, generally known

examples.en: The weather is generally warm in July in my hometown.
examples.cn: 七月在我家乡天气通常很温暖。

examples.en: Students generally find English grammar more difficult than vocabulary.
examples.cn: 学生们通常觉得英语语法比词汇更难。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想描述一种情况在大多数时候都发生，你会用哪个词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示“通常”、“普遍”的意思，强调事情发生的频率很高。

sentences: ___ speaking, the exam was easier than we expected.

image_prompts: A serene forest clearing with a small, moss-covered mound of earth, wildflowers scattered around
An ancient stone coffin partially submerged in sand, surrounded by desert landscape
words.image_desc_en: A place where something is buried.
words.image_desc_cn: 埋葬的地方。
words.collocations: funeral burial, mass burial
words.preposition_combos: at a burial, after the burial

examples.en: The ancient burial site was discovered during the road construction.
examples.cn: 在道路施工期间，发现了古老的墓地。

examples.en: His burial will take place next to his beloved wife.
examples.cn: 他将被安葬在他深爱的妻子旁边。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个人去世了，我们通常会做什么来纪念他/她？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指的是将遗体放入地下或海中的行为。

sentences: The pharaoh's ___ chamber was filled with treasures and artifacts.

image_prompts: A gleaming gold medal with a laurel wreath, presented on a velvet cushion
A framed certificate of achievement hanging on a wall, spotlight shining on it
words.image_desc_en: A medal and a certificate representing honor.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表荣誉的奖牌和证书。
words.meaning_cn: n. 荣誉，光荣；v. 尊敬，给予荣誉
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 honored, 过去分词 honored)
words.collocations: in honor of, with honor, great honor, honor someone with

examples.en: It is a great honor to be invited to speak here today.
examples.cn: 今天能被邀请到这里发言，我感到非常荣幸。

examples.en: We should honor our parents and teachers for their guidance.
examples.cn: 我们应该尊敬我们的父母和老师，感谢他们的指导。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你在比赛中获得了第一名，你会得到什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示因成就而获得的尊重和奖励。

sentences: The school decided to ___ the top students at the graduation ceremony.

image_prompts: A family tree diagram with portraits in oval frames, faded and aged
Ancient pottery shards and tools displayed in a glass case, museum exhibit
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting family history and ancient artifacts.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘家族历史和古代文物的插图。
words.collocations: distant ancestor, direct ancestor, family ancestor

examples.en: My ancestors came from Ireland many years ago, seeking new opportunities.
examples.cn: 我的祖先多年前从爱尔兰来，寻求新的机会。

examples.en: We should respect our ancestors and remember their contributions to society.
examples.cn: 我们应该尊重我们的祖先，并记住他们对社会的贡献。

socratic_questions.question: 如果我们要追溯家族的历史，那些比爷爷奶奶辈更早的人，我们称为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指家族中更早的、已故的长辈。

sentences: The old house had portraits of the family's ___ hanging on the walls.

image_prompts: A gold trophy on a pedestal with celebratory confetti around it
A checkered flag waving at the finish line of a race track
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting triumph and success.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘胜利和成功的图像。
words.collocations: win a victory, achieve victory, sweet victory

examples.en: Our team fought hard and finally achieved a great victory.
examples.cn: 我们的队伍努力奋斗，最终取得了一场伟大的胜利。

examples.en: The athlete celebrated his victory with a big smile on his face.
examples.cn: 这位运动员脸上带着灿烂的笑容庆祝他的胜利。

socratic_questions.question: 在一场激烈的比赛后，你获得了第一名，这代表着什么？

image_prompts: A chessboard with pieces arranged in a tense standoff, dark and dramatic lighting
Two flags of opposing nations planted on a battlefield, smoke and debris scattered around
words.image_desc_en: Visual representations of opposition and conflict.
words.image_desc_cn: 对立和冲突的视觉表现。
words.collocations: common enemy, sworn enemy, defeat the enemy

examples.en: Pollution is a common enemy that we must fight together.
examples.cn: 污染是我们必须共同对抗的共同敌人。

examples.en: He considered anyone who disagreed with him to be an enemy.
examples.cn: 他认为任何不同意他的人都是敌人。

socratic_questions.question: 在战争或竞争中，你最想击败的是什么？

sentences: Lack of sleep can be your worst ___ during exams.

image_prompts: A full stop at the end of a sentence on a textbook page
A historical timeline displayed on a museum wall, showing different eras
words.image_desc_en: A full stop and a timeline.
words.image_desc_cn: 句号和时间轴。
words.collocations: time period, historical period, school period

examples.en: The history class covers the period from 1900 to 1950.

examples.en: Put a period at the end of the sentence, please.

sentences: The sun provides a lot of ___ for our planet.

image_prompts: A chess board with pieces strategically placed, focused lighting
A GPS navigation screen showing a precise location on a map, satellite view
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations showing strategic placement and precise location.
words.image_desc_cn: 展示战略位置和精确定位的插图。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 positioned, 过去分词 positioned)
words.collocations: in a position, position yourself, leading position
words.preposition_combos: in a position to do sth, position on

examples.en: The school is in a great position near the park.
examples.cn: 学校的位置很好，靠近公园。

examples.en: He wants to position himself as a leader in the club.
examples.cn: 他想把自己定位为俱乐部里的领导者。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想描述某物在空间中的具体地点，或者你在团队中的角色，你会用哪个词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词既可以指具体的地点，也可以指抽象的角色或状态。

sentences: The correct answer is in the third ___ on the list.
